definitions.explanation: A literary expression meaning without a name, unknown, or humble. Used to modify nouns and conveys a poetic or elevated tone.

examples.japanese: {名|な}もなき⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
{名|な}もなき⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犠牲|ぎせい}→犠牲：14743_gisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: We must not forget the sacrifices of the unknown soldiers.

examples.japanese: {名|な}もなき⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}えている→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧。
examples.english: The daily efforts of ordinary, unknown people support society.

notes:
A literary or poetic expression meaning "nameless" or "unknown." Composed of ⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧ (name) + ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (even/also) + なき (classical negative form of ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧, meaning "without"). The classical なき gives it a formal, literary feel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名|な}もなき⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧: nameless flowers
- {名|な}もなき⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: unknown person; ordinary person
- {名|な}もなき⟦{英雄|えいゆう}→英雄：14117_eiyuu⟧: unsung hero
- {名|な}もなき⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧: unknown soldier

REGISTER:
This is a literary expression. In everyday speech, ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ or ⟦{無名|むめい}→無名：13420_mumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ would be used instead. {名|な}もなき appears in literature, poetry, titles of works, and formal rhetoric.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無名|むめい}→無名：13420_mumei⟧: anonymous, unknown — neutral, everyday register
- ⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: nameless — modern equivalent, less literary
